title: Arbitrum Stablecoin Growth Program
description: Performance-based incentives from the Arbitrum Foundation for live, stablecoin-centric protocols (lending, yield, AMMs, payments) that make USDG their primary stablecoin on Arbitrum. The first 10 teams to reach $10M of USDG TVL, as a 30-day average, each receive an additional 200K ARB from a 2M ARB prize pool.
reward: Performance-based incentives linked to growth on Arbitrum, plus 200K ARB each for the first 10 teams to reach $10M of USDG TVL (2M ARB prize pool)
summary: Incentives, plus 200K ARB for the first 10 teams · no deadline stated
ideas: A lending market with USDG as main collateral
A payments app settling in USDG on Arbitrum
A yield vault built around USDG deposits

eligibility.note: at least $1M in stablecoin balances at application, verified on DefiLlama
stablecoins at the core of the product, with audited contracts

setup: commit to USDG as your primary stablecoin on Arbitrum
each_time: stablecoin TVL, deployed contracts and audits
rules: No deadline is stated. The Arbitrum team reviews every application and contacts teams that are a fit.
Eligible: at least $1M in stablecoin balances at the time of application, verified on DefiLlama.
Stablecoins at the core of the product, with a live product and audited contracts.
A commitment to building on Arbitrum, with new deployments and launches happening there.
USDG as the primary stablecoin on Arbitrum, with at least $1M of TVL moving into USDG.
Accepted teams may get performance-based incentives linked to growth on the Arbitrum Platform, plus marketing, partner introductions, technical support and potential DRIP incentives.
The first 10 teams to reach $10M of USDG TVL, measured as a 30-day average, each receive 200K ARB.
Participation is subject to eligibility, approval by the Arbitrum Foundation and the Program Terms and Conditions.
